```artifact
Feature: Alarms

  Scenario: High Leakage Alarm
    Given the average leakage over 10 seconds is 4 L/min
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the "high leakage" alarm should be active
    And the alarm should be high priority

  Scenario: High Leakage Alarm with Edge Value
    Given the average leakage over 10 seconds is 3 L/min
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the "high leakage" alarm should not be active

  Scenario: High Leakage Alarm with Invalid Value
    Given the average leakage over 10 seconds is "n/a"
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the "high leakage" alarm should not be active

  Scenario: Involuntary Shutdown Alarm
    Given the system detects an involuntary shutdown
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the "involuntary shutdown" alarm should be active
    And the alarm should be a continuous-tone alarm
    And the alarm should emit a sound tone for at least 2 minutes

  Scenario: Involuntary Shutdown Alarm with Edge Value
    Given the system detects an involuntary shutdown
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the "involuntary shutdown" alarm should be active
    And the alarm should be a continuous-tone alarm
    And the alarm should emit a sound tone for at least 2 minutes

  Scenario: Involuntary Shutdown Alarm with Invalid Value
    Given the system detects an involuntary shutdown
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the "involuntary shutdown" alarm should be active
    And the alarm should be a continuous-tone alarm
    And the alarm should emit a sound tone for at least 2 minutes

  Scenario: AC Mains Power Loss Alarm
    Given the AC mains power loss sensor detects a loss
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the AC mains power loss alarm should be active
    And the alarm should be medium priority

  Scenario: AC Mains Power Loss Alarm with Edge Value
    Given the AC mains power loss sensor detects a loss
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the AC mains power loss alarm should be active
    And the alarm should be medium priority

  Scenario: AC Mains Power Loss Alarm with Invalid Value
    Given the AC mains power loss sensor detects a loss
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the AC mains power loss alarm should be active
    And the alarm should be medium priority
```
